title: Points of Judgement: The Benefit Treated as Consumed When Coverage Passes On
content:
When coverage under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans passes to a new owner, the benefit treated as consumed is read from the settlements booked to the plan over a period fixed by what the settlement and allowance entries show.

Where a settlement entry stands on the plan in the 12 months to the handling date and an allowance entry stands inside the coverage year in progress, the benefit consumed is the benefit taken by the settlements booked since that allowance entry. Where a settlement entry stands in those 12 months and no allowance entry stands inside the coverage year in progress, the benefit consumed is the benefit taken by the settlements booked in those 12 months. In any other case the benefit consumed is the benefit taken by every settlement booked to the plan.

## Which settlements are read

| Settlement entries in the 12 months to the handling date | Allowance entries inside the coverage year in progress | The benefit consumed |
|---|---|---|
| one or more | one or more | the benefit taken by the settlements booked since that allowance entry |
| one or more | none | the benefit taken by the settlements booked in those 12 months |
| none | either | the benefit taken by every settlement booked to the plan |

Settlements stand on the plan as movements out of the allowance, so the benefit they took is read as the size of those movements.

## Worked reading

A plan carrying settlements of 600.00 USD booked 10 whole months ago and 400.00 USD booked 2 whole months ago, with an allowance entry standing inside the coverage year in progress booked 4 whole months ago: a settlement stands in the 12 months to the handling date and an allowance entry stands inside that coverage year, so the benefit consumed is the benefit taken since that allowance entry, being 400.00 USD. Where no allowance entry stood inside that coverage year, the benefit consumed would instead be the benefit taken in those 12 months, being 1000.00 USD.
